matches.description: Watch Stockport County vs Wycombe Wanderers highlights and goals from League One on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on April 3, 2026. The tension was palpable as the two sides took to the pitch for a crucial League One showdown. Played on April 3, 2026 , the match served as a stern test of nerves and tactical discipline, with both teams eager to secure vital points. Establishing the tempo Early exchanges saw both teams fighting for midfield dominance, but it was Wycombe Wanderers who drew first blood. In the 23rd minute, Adama Sidibeh found the back of the net to give the visitors a lead that they would carry into the break despite growing pressure from the hosts. Turning the tide The second half injected fresh energy into the match, and it didn't take long for the momentum to shift. In the 53rd minute, Adam Phillips leveled the score for Stockport County after a pinpoint assist from Corey O'Keeffe . The game hung in the balance until the 71st minute, when a penalty was awarded to the visitors. Oliver Norwood stepped up and calmly converted from the spot, putting his team back in the driver's seat. As the clock ticked toward full time, the match descended into a flurry of cards and frantic play. The final word belonged to Wycombe Wanderers in the 90+9th minute, as Benony Andresson capitalized on an assist from Odin Bailey to score, cementing a 3-1 victory that reflected the visitors' resilience in the dying moments.
